title: Smoky Korean Pork Skewers
description: A sweet and spicy Korean-inspired recipe for pork skewers with a smoky flavor.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine chili flakes, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, honey, and lime juice. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended mixture and sesame oil. Add the pork shoulder and toss to coat.
Thread the pork onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.
Brush the skewers with the remaining marinade during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
